text:
emma-peopleops: Quick flag 176 interviews created in the last 6 hours show up with a blank scorecard in the scheduler UI. Interviewers are getting an invite but the rubric section is empty.

jordan-recruiting: Yikes. Are these across roles or concentrated?

emma-peopleops: Primarily SWE IC roles, looks like interviews created via the new `bulk-schedule` flow from ATS export.

anya-eng: Could be the template service migration we did last night. If the scheduler expects `scorecard_template_id` but the export has `eval_template_id` we might drop it. Can you paste a sample ATS payload?

emma-peopleops: Sample sanitized payload below (from ATS bulk export job 2026-04-01):

```
{
  "interview_id": "I-9981",
  "candidate": "C-8882",
  "role": "backend-engineer",
  "start_time": "2026-04-01T18:00:00Z",
  "interviewers": ["leah@redwood.com"],
  "eval_template_id": "tmpl-v2-legacy-123",
  "notes": "Bring system design prompt",
  "attachments": []
}
```

anya-eng: That field name `eval_template_id` should have been mapped by the ats-mapping lambda to `scorecard_template_id`. Looks like the lambda was updated to the new SDK and we missed a deprecated alias. The lambda is returning null for that key which leaves the scheduler to create a blank scorecard.

templatebot: [template-service] 2026-04-01T12:12:01Z WARN missing_template_alias eval_template_id=tmpl-v2-legacy-123 resolved=false

sam-product: What is the impact on interviews? Are candidates or interviewers blocked?

emma-peopleops: Interviews go ahead, but interviewers see "No scorecard assigned" and some have asked for guidance. We also lose structured feedback for those interviews if interviewers forget to attach a manual rubric.

jordan-recruiting: Priority: we need (1) restore mapping so future schedules include the right template, (2) backfill upcoming interviews (48h) with correct template, (3) communicate to interviewers on how to manually pick the template if they want now.

anya-eng: Plan: revert the mapping lambda to the previous version that included alias handling (will take ~30m), then run a backfill job that queries interviews with scorecard=null and uses `eval_template_id` to PATCH scheduler.assign_scorecard. I'll coordinate with infra for a small window.

emma-peopleops: For communication, can we use a short message: "Heads up: some interviews may show no scorecard. If youre interviewing, click Assign > Select 'Backend IC v2' in the scheduler. We'll patch invites automatically if you prefer." Keep it candidate-safe.

jordan-recruiting: I'll send that to the interviewer roster and add an FAQ in the invite body with the manual steps.

templatebot: [deploy-bot] 2026-04-01T12:45:00Z user=anya-eng env=prod change=revert->ats-mapping-lambda@v1.9.2

anya-eng: Revert deployed. Running backfill against interviews starting in next 48h. Script will match on eval_template_id and call scheduler.assign_scorecard(interview_id, template_id). Dry-run indicates 176 rows to patch.

emma-peopleops: Please add an audit tag `scorecard-backfill-20260401` and include who ran it. We need that for compliance.

anya-eng: Backfill completed: patched 176 interviews. Audit tag added. Leaving a note on each interview: "scorecard auto-assigned from eval_template_id; if incorrect, please contact recruiting."

jordan-recruiting: Confirmed: spot-checked 12 interviews across roles, scorecards present and rubrics look correct. Sending a short FYI to interviewers + instructions on manual assign.

emma-peopleops: Can we add a CI check in the mapping lambda unit tests to assert both `eval_template_id` and `scorecard_template_id` are accepted paths? Also a monitor that alerts if >3 interviews created without scorecard in 1 hour.

anya-eng: Yes, adding unit test and an alert rule in infra. Will also add an integration test that runs against a staging ATS sample.

sam-product: Thanks all. Let's also log this as a retro action: clearer schema versioning between ATS export and mapping lambda.

emma-peopleops: Closing loop 176 patched, unit tests + monitor queued. Thanks everyone :clap:
